EULA.description: Type TRUE to accept the Minecraft EULA (https://aka.ms/MinecraftEULA) - the server is created once you do

CRAFTY_ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Password for the panel's 'admin' login, set on first boot only - change it in Crafty afterwards

PORT.description: Port the panel listens on behind the Railway domain - leave as is

RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_DRAINING_SECONDS.description: Time to save the world and stop the server cleanly on redeploy

RAILWAY_HEALTHCHECK_TIMEOUT_SEC.description: How long the first boot may take before the healthcheck gives up. Small plans start this image slowly, so allow 10 minutes. Do not change.
